segments.speaker: ithar
segments.transcript: "Then consider whether obeying it would improve your condition."

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
I opened the pack.

Half a heel of hard bread.

Dried meat that had crossed the mountain better than I had.

One apple which had become mostly bruise.

I held it up.

"Dinner."

Ithar stared at the apple.

Then at me.
